title: Stage Directions
skills: define stage directions in dramatic texts
identify how stage directions guide movement, tone, and action
analyze how stage directions shape characterization and audience understanding
interpret the relationship between written drama and performance
alignment_note: Introduces stage directions as an essential feature of dramatic texts and explains how they guide action, movement, tone, and performance. Supports close reading of plays, analysis of dramatic structure, interpretation of characterization, and understanding of how written drama becomes performance across high school English courses.
